reviewPackets.title: Consolidated best quotes versus last trade
reviewPackets.teachingClaim: The best displayed national bid and offer represent quoted interests under relevant market-data rules. A completed last-sale print records a trade, not the price guaranteed for the next order.

reviewPackets.teachingLimit: Consolidated feeds, odd lots, latency, auctions, hidden orders and market conditions can affect displayed and executable prices.

reviewPackets.teachingLimit: Quoted spread changes with time and feed; effective realized spread and actual transaction costs require execution data.
